notes: This file is auto-generated by build_catalog.py but is INTENTIONALLY human-editable: add new values to any field's slot "values" array as the community discovers them. Re-running the generator merges in any newly-seen values without removing your additions, AS LONG AS your additions live in skills_catalog_overrides.json.
Mirror/numbered fields (e.g. SKILLSTATUS2, SKILLSTATUSCONDITION3) are collapsed onto their base field name; the original observed names are listed in the field's "mirrors" array for reference.
Numeric slots only record the type(s) observed (int/float). String slots record the full set of observed values.

Format version 2 adds the structural rules taken from skills_field_reference.txt: "format" (shape prose), "multi" (may repeat inside one record), "links" (fields that must appear together), "requires" (structured prerequisites; unparseable prose is kept under "raw" and is never enforced) and "notes". Enum values documented in the reference file are unioned into the observed values.

engine.source: GameCube boot DOL (SkillLoadTokenFile / FUN_80026ec0 field tables)

SKILLAFFCOST.note: Affinity cost. Free-form integer input; not enumerated.
SKILLAFFCOST.format: integer (divide by 20 to get actual orb cost)

SKILLAFFINITY.note: "None" means any affinity type is accepted.

SKILLANIM.note: Animation name for the skill. Valid values are sourced at runtime from character .pan files via a multi-step lookup: (1) read each SKILLUSECLASS value on the current skill; (2) find the matching SKILLUSENAME entry in data/config/classdefs.tok to get the MESH name; (3) list data/characters/<mesh>/ for .pan files whose filename contains an underscore; (4) take everything after the underscore, strip the extension. Only values that exist across ALL resolved meshes should be offered. If the skill has no SKILLUSECLASS lines, show nothing and warn the user that a SKILLUSECLASS is required. The main animation played by the caster.

SKILLANIMSPEED.note: Animation name (slot 0) and speed multiplier (slot 1). The animation name follows the same lookup as SKILLANIM: resolve SKILLUSECLASS -> classdefs.tok MESH -> data/characters/<mesh>/ .pan files with underscores -> name after underscore. The speed multiplier is free-form numeric: a value of 0.5 makes the animation run at half speed (twice as slow); higher values speed it up. If the skill has no SKILLUSECLASS lines, show nothing and warn the user that a SKILLUSECLASS is required. Playback speed multiplier for SKILLANIM.

SKILLANIMSTARTFRAME.note: Frame offset into SKILLANIM to start playback.

SKILLANIMTIME.note: Animation name (slot 0) and duration in seconds (slot 1). The animation name follows the same lookup as SKILLANIM: resolve SKILLUSECLASS -> classdefs.tok MESH -> data/characters/<mesh>/ .pan files with underscores -> name after underscore. The duration is free-form numeric: the animation is sped up or slowed down to fit exactly that many seconds (e.g. 0.5 = half-second). If the skill has no SKILLUSECLASS lines, show nothing and warn the user that a SKILLUSECLASS is required. Duration override for the animation in seconds (or frames — unknown).

SKILLATTRIBUTE.note: Each attribute line adds one attribute to the skill. "weapon" = uses equipped weapon and applies weapon item skills; "shield" = uses equipped shield. "teleport" requires SKILLMOVERANGE to also be present. "movetoattack" requires SKILLMOVETOATTACKMOD to also be present.

SKILLCHARGEANIM.note: Animation played during the meter/charge phase.

SKILLCOMBATMODS.note: Combat modifier values: integer accuracy modifier, decimal damage multiplier. Free-form numeric input; not enumerated. accuracy_modifier: integer added to hit chance (0 = normal accuracy). damage_multiplier: float; 1.0 = 100% of base damage.

SKILLCOMBOBUTTON.note: The button input that triggers this combo step. Only appears in Combo and ComboChain skills. It denotes which button on the face buttons will be hit at this step.

requires.raw: A ComboChain ability that calls `SKILLSUBSKILL: "CLASS ComboChain ##"`

SKILLCOSTS.note: Turn cost (decimal, 1.0 = 1 turn) and SP cost (x10). Free-form numeric input; not enumerated. First value = turn cost (usually 1, lower to make next turn come faster, higher for slower). Second value = SP cost multiplied by 10 (e.g. 20 = 2 SP).

slots.note: free-form internal skill name; not enumerated

SKILLCREATE.note: The name must be unique across the file. type and category are always present (both quoted).

SKILLDEFENDHANIM.note: Animation played by the DEFENDER when hit by this skill.

SKILLDESCRIPTIONID.note: Integer ID into lookuptext_eng.txt. Sourced from that file; the GUI should resolve it there rather than from this catalog. Lookup ID for the flavour description text. Optional.

SKILLDISPLAYNAMEID.note: Integer ID into lookuptext_eng.txt. Sourced from that file; the GUI should resolve it there rather than from this catalog. Lookup ID into lookuptext_eng.txt for the player-visible skill name.

SKILLDISTANCEDELAY.note: Two floats — exact meaning unknown. Seen values: "1.6, 3.75" and "4, 3.75". Likely a distance-to-delay mapping for projectile timing.

SKILLEFFECT.note: chance = integer 0-100 (percentage). value  = integer or float depending on the effect name. Multiple SKILLEFFECT lines = multiple effects applied on hit. "Summon" requires SKILLSUMMONDATA. "ShiftTo" / "ShiftReturn" requires SKILLSHIFTDATA.

SKILLEFFECTCONDITION.note: Filters which units are actually affected by the skill. "targetstatus req/ign <status>" uses a status name (see SKILLSTATUS names).

SKILLEFFECTRANGE.note: Defines the AoE footprint originating from the targetted tile. Self is for applying the skill to the caster, typically used on Support skills

SKILLEFFECTSKILLCOND.note: Condition in order to trigger an effect. For example, an attack that only poisons if the user uses a specific set of skills they have learned.

SKILLEFFECTSTATUSCOND.note: Status the TARGET must have for SKILLEFFECT to fire.

SKILLFREE.note: References another skill by its internal name. Used for combo skills, transform/form abilities (so the resulting form has access to skills), and some riposte/counter abilities. Must match a SKILLCREATE name defined elsewhere in the file; not enumerated here. A skill granted for free alongside this skill (slot 1 of 4). Free skill slot 2. Free skill slot 3. Free skill slot 4.

SKILLFX.note: Particle/visual effect played on the caster or at the point of impact.

SKILLFXCTAG.note: FX contact tag (bone or attachment point on the character).

SKILLFXMOVE.note: Visual effect played during movement phase.

SKILLFXPROJECTILE.note: Visual effect used as the projectile.

SKILLFXPROJECTILEIMPACT.note: Visual effect played on projectile impact.

SKILLFXSWING.note: Swing FX reference. Sourced from FX/animation files; free-form string, not enumerated here. Visual effect played during the weapon swing.

SKILLJOBPOINTCOST.note: Integer. -1 = hidden skill, 0 = free skill, >=1 = costs that many Job Points. JP cost to learn the skill.

SKILLLEVEL.note: Integer 1–30 (vanilla also uses 0 for innate/auto-granted skills). Skill tier/level; -1 means not level-gated. THIS IS NOT CURRENTLY USED BY THE GAME BUT SHOULD BE SET FOR GOOD READING

SKILLMETER.note: Combat meter type. Valid values are sourced at runtime from data/config/skillmeter.tok. Parse every line beginning with METERCREATE: and take the first quoted argument (e.g. 'METERCREATE: "pound1" "Masher"' -> 'pound1'). The GUI should load and cache this file to populate the dropdown. Controls the timing minigame shown during the skill. For Chain/ChainSlow: third value = total number of hits in the combo. When type = Chain or ChainSlow, SKILLSUBSKILL should also be present.

SKILLMOVEANIM.note: Animation played while the unit moves (charge/move-to-attack).

SKILLMOVERANGE.note: Range and shape of where the unit can teleport to.

SKILLMOVERANGECONDITION.note: Additional condition on the destination tile.

SKILLMOVETOATTACKMOD.note: Extra (+) or reduced (-) movement tiles available when using Move-to-Attack with this skill.

requires.raw: This is a required line prior to SKILLMOVETOATTACKMOD: SKILLATTRIBUTE = "movetoattack"

SKILLMULTIHITDATA.note: String of direction letters defining which tiles a multi-hit skill strikes, relative to the caster's facing. Each letter is one hit: A=front-left, B=in-front, C=front-right, D=right, E=back-right, F=behind, G=back-left, H=left. Free-form string input; not enumerated here. One SKILLMULTIHITDATA line per hit in the multi-hit sequence. Each line is a string of letters indicating which adjacent tiles that hit affects (e.g. "BC" hits the tile in front and front-right).
SKILLMULTIHITDATA.format: string of position letters per hit (see VALUES)

SKILLPREREQ.note: References another skill by its internal name. Marks a prerequisite skill that must be learned before this one; typically used for skill progressions (e.g. Affinity Attack 1 unlocks Affinity Attack 2). Must match a SKILLCREATE name defined elsewhere in the file; not enumerated here. The skill that must be learned before this one is available.
SKILLPREREQ.format: skill name string (no quotes in vanilla)

SKILLPROJECTILE.note: Name of the projectile object/asset used for the visual.

SKILLPROJECTILEATTR.note: "indirect" = no line of sight required. "multifire" = fires multiple projectiles. "nontarget" = projectile does not lock onto target. "return"    = projectile returns to caster.

SKILLPROJECTILEROTATION.note: Rotation axis (x/y/z flags 0 or 1) and rotation speed. Exact semantics unknown — mark known meaning here.

SKILLPROJECTILESEQUENCE.note: Controls how multiple projectiles (multifire) sequence and travel.

SKILLPROXY.note: Links this skill to another skill that acts as its proxy/upgrade. proxy_type values seen: "affinity4", "Affinity4". Exact mechanics unknown.

SKILLRANGE.note: range = integer tile count. When range = 0 and pattern = "Self", the skill uses SKILLEFFECTRANGE instead to define its AoE footprint.

SKILLREPLACES.note: This skill replaces the named skill in the class's skill list.

SKILLSHIFTDATA.format: "class", "variant", v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7
SKILLSHIFTDATA.note: Stat modifiers applied when ShiftTo fires. class + variant identify the shift target form. v1-v7 appear to be numeric stat deltas (exact mapping unknown). Add REQUIRES: SKILLEFFECT.name = ShiftTo once confirmed.

SKILLSOUND.note: Sound reference. Sourced from sound/animation files; free-form string, not enumerated here. Sound ID in the game's sound bank.
SKILLSOUND.format: "NNN.NNN"  (two three-digit numbers separated by a dot)

SKILLSPLITEFFECT.note: Like SKILLEFFECT but combines with SKILLSPLITEFFECTCONDITION to allow a skill to do multiple things. Value in quotations can match anything SKILLEFFECT can use, numeric value influences the SKILLEFFECT e.g.: SKILLSPLITEFFECT: "Shield Restore", 100, 1 < 100% chance to restore shieldmelt SKILLSPLITEFFECT: "Change HP Relative", -0.1 < decreases targets hp by 10%

SKILLSPLITEFFECTCONDITION.note: The condition that triggers the split behaviour. This can be used to get different effects on units depending on the value being evaluated.

SKILLSTATUS.note: Skill Statuses SKILLSTATUS: "status", 100, 1 Status is from option below, 100 is chance to apply, 1 is dependent on the effect. You can also do SKILLSTATUS2: "status", 100, 1 to add a second status to a skill hpregen noncumulative - hp regen, 1 is how much per tick (not sure what noncumulative means) damage multiply - didn't play with this one, i assume just a flat damage multiplier buff/debuff though (either damage done or damage taken) set step down limit - how far down you can jump (not really used), 1 is how much set step up limit - how far up you can jump, 1 is how much (used on cats). Only really works on innates. change off affinity charge rate - flat change to how much affinity you gain offensively. mult off affinity charge rate - percent change to how much affinity you gain offensively. change def affinity charge rate - flat change to how much affinity you gain defensively mult def affinity charge rate - percent change to how much affinity you gain defensively bleeding - damage over time, 1 is how much per interval poison - damage over time, 1 is how much per interval shieldmelt - damage over time to shield, 1 is how much per tick confusion - give confusion status, 1 does nothing blind - give blind status, 1 does nothing charm - give charm status, 1 does nothing fear - give fear status, 1 does nothing berserk - give berserk status, 1 does nothing root - give root status, 1 does nothing petrification - petrify status, 1 does nothing frozen - frozen status, 1 does nothing stun - stun status, 1 does nothing summon - adds the summon status to a summoned creature (which is the status that allows it to remain in the world), 1 does nothing supercharge - Ursula and Valens' power up skill. 1 does nothing immortal - grants immortal status, 1 does nothing doom count - sets doom status, 1 is how many counts of doom (i believe auto-goes down on target's turn) ambush - basically just cover from archers, i don't think 1 does anything (maybe lets you fire multiple times per ambush?) ambush interrupt - the "back off" skills, stops the enemy movement as well as ambushes. i don't think 1 does anything (maybe lets you fire multiple times per ambush?) conditional activate - used in skills like berserker adrenaline that has a condition (like half health) to activate. Requires a subskill to know what to do when the condition is met. The 1 does nothing always face - always face target, 1 does nothing. Only seems to work on innates mult shield effectiveness - Multiply shield health, 1 is how much dropped item chance up - multiply dropped item chance (chance per item to drop when chests can drop), 1 is how much combatattack damagemult - increase/decrease by % the damage a gladiator does. 1 is the % combatdefend damagemult - increase/decrease by % the damage a gladiator takes. 1 is the % combatattack critmult - increase/decrease by % the damage a gladiator does in a crit. 1 is the % combatdefend critmult - increase/decrease by % the damage a gladiator takes in a crit. 1 is the % combatdefend defenseadd - flat add or remove a gladiator's defense, 1 is the number combatattack accuracyadd - flat add or remove a gladiator's accuracy, 1 is the number combatdefend face front mult - increase/decrease by % the damage a gladiator takes from the front. 1 is the % combatattack face front mult - increase/decrease by % the damage a gladiator does from the front. 1 is the % combatdefend face back mult - increase/decrease by % the damage a gladiator takes from the back. 1 is the % combatattack face back mult - increase/decrease by % the damage a gladiator does from the back. 1 is the % crowd no flubs - makes it so if you flub a meter, the crowd doesn't care, 1 does nothing crowd positive mult - multiplies the change to crowd meters you do, 1 is percent auto regen - set HP regen, number is amount of heal per tick simple counterattack - grants a .4 damage counter (used on the counter accessories, doesn't require any subskill). 1 is how many counters you do. immunity status - sets an immunity to a status (which is determined in skillstatuscondition) immunity counters - immune to counter attacks, 1 does nothing skill meta cost add - removes or adds SP cost to skills (only seems to work in innates). 1 is by how much in, 10 per SP. skill meta range add - removes or adds range for targeting, only seems to work in innates. 1 is by how much. skill meta effect range add - removes or adds area for AoE attacks, only seems to work in innates. 1 is by how much. skill meta effect mult - not entirely sure, but i think it adds or removes based on the effect (so like, you could make knockback do 2 squares instead of 1), only likely to work in innates. 1 is by how much. skill meta stack cost mult - removes or adds stack cost to skills (like pass being a half cost turn, you could make it a quarter turn with this), only seems to work in innates. 1 is by how much. skill meta status duration mult - removes or adds duration to skills, only seems to work in innates. 1 is by how much. skill meta status effect mult - removes or adds effects on skills (like making poison do more), only seems to work in innates. 1 is by how much. Not sure on this one honestly All of the below are pretty much the same, either change by a flat number or a %, the 1 is either the flat number or percent to change by. change moverate change moverate percent change power change power percent change accuracy change accuracy percent change defense change defense percent change initiative change initiative percent change movetoattack change movetoattack percent See SKILLSTATUSTARGET, SKILLSTATUSDURATION etc for the rest of slot 1. Second status slot. Add REQUIRES if it can only appear when SKILLSTATUS is also present, or if it is independent.

SKILLSTATUSCHANCE.note: Additional percentage gate for the whole slot 1 block. Only seen as 50, 80, 100 in vanilla.

SKILLSTATUSCONDITION.note: Condition the TARGET must meet for slot 1 status to be applied. Vanilla has fewer values here than SKILLSTATUSCONDITION. Likely same full list applies.

SKILLSTATUSDURATION.note: How long the slot 1 status lasts. Stack types: value is a count or multiplier. Turns types: value is number of turns. "Permanent" / "Until Negated": second value is 0 or 1 (unknown meaning).

SKILLSTATUSINTERVAL.note: How often a periodic status (e.g. poison ticks) fires.

SKILLSTATUSSITUATIONAFFINITYCONDITION.note: The source's current affinity element must match for slot 1 status to fire. e.g. `SKILLSTATUS: "combatdefend damagemult", 100, 1.5 SKILLSTATUSDURATION: "Permanent", 0 SKILLSTATUSCONDITION: "enemy only" SKILLSTATUSSITUATIONAFFINITYCONDITION: "affinity req water"` This combination will make the user take 50% bonus damage if the enemy has a water affinity item equipped or water affinity skill is used

SKILLSTATUSSITUATIONSKILLCONDITION.note: Same as SKILLSTATUSSITUATIONAFFINITYCONDITION but for different conditions.

SKILLSTATUSSITUATIONSTATUSCONDITION.note: Status the TARGET must have for slot 1 SKILLSTATUSSITUATION block to fire. Can also be used to make a unit immune to a condition e.g. `SKILLEFFECT: "Status Only", 100, 1 SKILLSTATUS: "immunity status", 0, 0 SKILLSTATUSSITUATIONSTATUSCONDITION: "statuscond blind" SKILLSTATUSCHANCE: 100` this makes a unit immune to being blind as a passive effect

SKILLSTATUSSITUATIONUNITCONDITION.note: Unit attribute condition for slot 1 SKILLSTATUSSITUATION block.

SKILLSTATUSTARGET.note: Who receives the status from slot 1. "Target Unit" = the skill's direct target. "Target Area Caster" = AoE around the caster. Who receives the slot 2 status.

SKILLSTATUSUSELIMIT.note: Limits how many times this skill's status can stack/apply. Only value seen in vanilla is 1.

SKILLSUBSKILL.note: References another skill by its internal name. Defines a skill that chains or combos from this one (e.g. a follow-up hit, counterattack trigger, or conditional activate payload). Must match a SKILLCREATE name defined elsewhere in the file; not enumerated here. Name of the next skill in a combo chain. That skill record has its own SKILLCREATE, SKILLCOMBATMODS, etc. Add REQUIRES/LINK here once combo linking rules are confirmed.

SKILLSUMMONDATA.note: Defines the unit summoned when SKILLEFFECT name = "Summon". variant = "default" in all vanilla cases. integer = unknown (0 in all vanilla cases). Add REQUIRES: SKILLEFFECT.name = Summon once confirmed.

SKILLTARGETCONDITION.note: Restricts which squares/units can be chosen as the skill target.

SKILLUSABILITYCONDITION.note: Condition on the SOURCE unit (or target) that must be true for the skill to appear as usable in the menu.

SKILLUSECLASS.note: Class names. Sourced from classdefs.tok rather than enumerated here. The GUI should populate this dropdown from classdefs.tok at load time. One line per class that can use this skill. The same skill name/ID can appear multiple times in the file, once per class (each with its own SKILLUSECLASS block). Multiple entries on one skill means multiple classes can use that skill. SKILLUSECLASS is found in classdefs.tok SKILLUSENAME field.

SKILLWEAPONREQ.note: Weapon type the unit must be equipped with to use this skill. The skill is still learned, it just won't show up until that item is equipped.
